name: codex-orchestration
description: Delegate bounded work to pinned native Codex subagents and review committed candidates.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate bounded work, review candidates, and accept with evidence.
interface.longDescription: Codex Orchestration keeps decision rights with the Parent and delegates bounded work through explicit model and effort selections. Subagents validate their changes; the Parent commits a candidate and commissions a fresh review before acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-orchestration:orchestration to plan, build, verify, and review this work.
Delegate bounded work with pinned settings and report validation and review evidence.
